summary: Banco Santander Chile filed a Form 6-K containing a routine management commentary for the period ended June 30, 2026. This is an ordinary quarterly business update, not a special situation filing. The report discusses forward-looking statements, accounting standards, and financial performance. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, or capital event is announced. The filing is a standard foreign issuer report under Rule 13a-16, providing periodic financial information without triggering any special-situations categorization. Therefore, the filing does not qualify as a special situation.
